chunks: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the day in which there is doubt whether it is from Sha'ban.
He said: 'That I fast a day from Sha'ban is more beloved to me than that I break the fast of a day from the month of Ramadan.'

key_terms.أَصُومَ: To fast (sawm) — fulfilling the Islamic obligation of fasting during Ramadan
key_terms.أُفْطِرَ: To break the fast (iftar) — ending the fast before sunset, which is forbidden in Ramadan without valid excuse
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ: Yawm al-shakk — the day of doubt, the final day of Sha'ban when uncertainty exists about whether Ramadan has begun
key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban — the eighth month of the Islamic calendar, directly preceding Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting on the day of doubt between Sha'ban and Ramadan in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Al-Kahili narrates that he asked Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the ruling on the 'day of doubt' (yawm al-shakk) — the last day of Sha'ban when it is unclear whether the crescent of Ramadan has been sighted. The Imam's response, expressed in the first person, indicates a cautious approach: he would prefer to observe an optional fast from Sha'ban on that uncertain day rather than risk inadvertently breaking a mandatory Ramadan fast. This reflects a jurisprudential principle of caution (ihtiyat) — when in doubt, one should choose the course of action that avoids the graver error, which in this context is missing a day of the obligatory Ramadan fast.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hamza Bin Ya’la, from Zakariyya Bin Adam, from Al Kahily who said, 
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the day in which there is a doubt, it is from Shaban.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If I<sup>asws</sup> were to Fast a day from Shaban, it would be more beloved to me<sup>asws</sup> than if I<sup>asws</sup> were to break the Fast of the Month of Ramazan’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hamzah ibn Ya‘liy from Zakariya ibn Adam from al- Kahiliy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of the day that is not known to be of the month of al-Sha’ban.
He (the Imam) said, ’Fasting one day of the month of al-Sha’ban is more beloved to me than losing one day of the month of Ramadan.”’
